before_outputs: frozen before any E13 candidate, training or test output; no model has been run on these words
readings: the first CMUdict reading; words whose readings differ beyond stress (heteronyms) are excluded; names keep their English (CMUdict) reading
exclusions: protected families (E03 dev/eval, E02 held-out, benchmark panels, reserve; Latin inputs only)
E10 confirmation, E10/E11 review and E12 test words and families
romanised forms, abbreviations, ambiguous readings, derived name forms, offensive
selection: E12's balanced sampler (length quotas 13/14/13, vowel and cluster caps) per category
distribution: declared balanced evaluation distribution (40 ordinary, 40 irregular, 40 names); not a sample of real usage
